convergent_findings.title: cardGame.ts reimplements TCG combat in parallel with tcg-core; uses Math.random() mid-mutation
convergent_findings.summary: The cardGame router defines its own GameState/PlayerState types and hand-rolls combat outside tcg-core, calls Math.random() mid-mutation (line 1266), and lacks db.transaction() wrapping on pack-opening (1749) and currency flows. Replay determinism, RULES_VERSION discipline, and economic atomicity all break here.
convergent_findings.fix: Make cardGame.ts an auth+persistence shell only. Route gameplay through tcg-core's reduce(); replace Math.random() with createRng(seed) from engine/rng.ts; wrap pack/grant flows in db.transaction. Add ship-check server.cardGame_uses_engine that fails on Math.random in this file.

convergent_findings.title: 175 of 199 publicProcedures lack rate limits; economic surfaces wide open
convergent_findings.summary: procedureRateLimit exists (well-built at _core/procedureRateLimit.ts) but is applied at only 4 callsites across 199 publicProcedures. Casino plays, marketplace mutations, tradeWars actions, battlePass.addXp (10000 XP/call cap, total pass = 15750), pvp.getLeaderboard, and elara.chat (unbounded LLM cost) are all unprotected. Performance and economist personas confirm this is exploitable for currency farming, leaderboard scraping, and credit-card-incinerator LLM abuse.
convergent_findings.fix: Add procedureRateLimit({windowMs:60_000, max:30}) to all casino play* and marketplace/trading mutations; max:5 on claimJackpot/placeBid; max:5 on elara.chat. Delete battlePass.addXp or cap to max:200 + rate limit. Move bucket store to Redis before horizontal scale. Add ship-check security.public_procedure_rate_limit_coverage.

convergent_findings.title: iapReceipt.verify is a stub — RevenueCat receipt grants nothing or replays infinitely
convergent_findings.summary: iapReceipt.verify validates the RevenueCat REST response and returns {ok:true,orderId} but never writes to storePurchases, never calls fulfillPurchase, and has no (userId,platform,transactionId) unique index. The docstring's 'Idempotent' claim is aspirational comment. Either iOS/Android purchasers get nothing or — if client trusts ok:true — any receipt is replayable indefinitely.
convergent_findings.fix: Implement recordIapFulfillment() upserting storePurchases keyed on transactionId via db.transaction; add unique index on (userId,platform,transactionId); block native binary deploy until verify returns a real fulfilled orderId. Gate route behind feature flag until wired.

convergent_findings.title: GameContext.tsx is a 3,960-line monolithic provider with fresh-object value every render
convergent_findings.summary: One context exposes ~150 callbacks across 17+ domains; provider value is an inline object literal so identity changes every render, nullifying 126 useCallback/useMemo sites. Any setState (morality, hotspot, flag, autosave) re-renders ArkExplorerPage(2848), ChessPage(2547), FightPage(2158), DuelystGameUI(2043) simultaneously. App.tsx:614-626 amplifies by rebuilding a Set on every flag flip.
convergent_findings.fix: Split into Zustand/Jotai stores per domain (awakening, rooms, cards, morality, companion, factionWar). useMemo the provider value as an immediate fix. Split GameStateContext from GameActionsContext. Move setNarrativeFlag effect into a domain store with selector subscription.

convergent_findings.title: Economic mutations span multiple writes with zero db.transaction() — pack-opening, gem bundles, auctions all non-atomic
convergent_findings.summary: cardGame.ts has zero db.transaction() calls. Pack-opening sequences UPDATE(dreamBalance) → UPDATE(userCards) → INSERT(userCards) without atomicity — crash mid-sequence duplicates currency or destroys cards. Marketplace placeBid has TOCTOU on endsAt and 4 separate writes, allowing snipe/lost-update/escrow-loss. The economist confirms this is a direct economic exploit, not theoretical.
convergent_findings.fix: Wrap all >1-row currency/inventory mutations in db.transaction(async tx => ...). Mirror store.ts:purchaseWithDream pattern (conditional UPDATE + transaction). Add anti-snipe extension on placeBid (endsAt = GREATEST(endsAt, NOW()+60s)). Tighten the existing db.economic_transaction_coverage ratchet (currently 12) to 0 by closing the named callsites.

convergent_findings.title: Migration journal is a Potemkin facade; db:push is the actual prod deploy mechanism
convergent_findings.summary: 42 of 81 .sql migration files have no journal entry; 9 prefix collisions (0037,0043-0047,0055,0058,0059). CI's db-smoke and e2e jobs run pnpm db:migrate:prod with continue-on-error:true because journal-tracked migrations 0045+ depend on orphans. Server compensates with ~25 bootstrap* IIFEs at startup. CLAUDE.md's claim that 'production deploys use db:migrate' is therefore false; prod schema is enforced by application cold-boot.
convergent_findings.fix: Execute step 2 of migrations/README.md: collapse history into a single 0071_baseline_v1 from a fresh DB. Flip both continue-on-error:true to false. Retire bootstrap* IIFEs once journaled. Add a CI gate: `db:migrate` must succeed on a clean MySQL container without continue-on-error.

convergent_findings.title: FK coverage is 6 references() vs 450 *Id columns; users table has 200+ unprotected dependents
convergent_findings.summary: The 301-gap ratchet undersells reality: schema actually has 6 .references() against 450 *Id columns. users.id has 200+ inbound dependents (userProgress, userAchievements, arkThemes, characterSheets, userBlocks, supportImpersonationGrants) all bare int(). Security flagged that support_impersonation_grants (line 174) without FKs is a privilege bridge. The promised follow-up at 0067_indexes_and_fks.sql:9 references a docs/operations/SCHEMA_FK_AUDIT.md that doesn't exist.
convergent_findings.fix: Tier the rollout: tier 1 cascade on user_progress, ark_themes, character_sheets, user_achievements; tier 2 restrict on pvp_matches, card_game_matches, game_replays.winnerId (mirroring existing 1174/1177 pattern); tier 3 restrict on store_purchases, market_transactions. After C-06 lands, FKs can deploy via journaled migration. Tighten db.foreign_key_coverage ratchet downward as each tier ships.

convergent_findings.title: Sentry/OTel are 'required in prod' env-wise but skip silently if SDK packages are missing — observability is potentially zero
convergent_findings.summary: env.ts requires SENTRY_DSN and OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT at boot, but sentry.ts and otel.ts wrap import('@sentry/node')/'@opentelemetry/...' in try/catch that skips silently. package.json has @sentry/node but ZERO @opentelemetry/* deps. Webhook errors log via console.error — invisible without Sentry. Performance flagged 89 console.* sites in client with no esbuild.drop. Combined: prod might be emitting nothing, and the team would not know.
convergent_findings.fix: Promote @opentelemetry/sdk-node + exporters to hard prod deps; convert dynamic imports to static; add ship-check that Sentry.getClient() and OTel SDK return non-null in prod. Configure vite esbuild.drop:['console','debugger'] for prod build. Replace webhook console.error with Sentry.captureException.

convergent_findings.title: E2E and unit tests run in CI but assert nothing meaningful — tautological matchers + no DB fixture for router tests
convergent_findings.summary: 143 of 165 server routers have no adjacent test (87% golden-path gap; chess.ts/architectConsole.ts/cardGame.ts have zero). E2E specs use class-prefix wildcards ([class*='chess']) that match anything; stripe-checkout asserts only not.toBe(500) (404 passes). accessibility-audit.spec.ts skips all auth-gated tests without E2E_AUTH_OPEN_ID — only / /terms /privacy get axe coverage. Router 'tests' have zero vi.mock and document 'no DB available, contract-only' — that follow-up never landed. vitest has no coverage reporter wired.
convergent_findings.fix: Stand up vitest.integration.config.ts using existing mysql:8.0 service container; add pnpm test:integration step to CI between db:smoke and e2e. Replace E2E class-prefix locators with data-testid; add real interactions. Install @vitest/coverage-v8 with thresholds {lines:60,branches:50}; ratchet upward. Add ship-check tests.golden_path_router_coverage and a11y.axe_violation_count.

convergent_findings.title: Onboarding is a wall of jargon: 28 of 30 LORE_TUTORIALS never fire; no glossary; tutorials announce nothing to AT users
convergent_findings.summary: useAutoTutorial is mounted on only 2 of ~30 surfaces despite LORE_TUTORIALS defining triggerRoute for all. Bridge Console (cold-open landing) is deliberately empty with no CTA. Authority §5.8 trial UI is incomprehensible without lore (jury cards, ink lines, §-notation, cross-exam phases). No glossary anywhere — hundreds of jargon terms (Ocularum, Synopticon, Ne-Yon, Identity Chains, Trial Categories) have no clickable definition. Tutorial overlays are plain divs (no role=dialog, no focus trap, typewriter outside aria-live). LoreTutorialEngine applies morality on click with no Back/Undo. Zero i18n extraction means components can't be translated.
convergent_findings.fix: Mount AutoTutorialPrompt at GameGate level (App.tsx:629) — one ~5-line change unlocks 28 authored tutorials. Add empty-state CTA on BridgeConsole. Author tut-authority-trial. Build LoreTerm component that surfaces loredex-data.json summaries via Radix tooltip; existing LoredexContext already loads the data. Wrap tutorial overlays in role=dialog aria-modal=true + useFocusTrap; place typewriter in aria-live=polite. Surface consequence preview before morality-applying choices commit. Introduce react-i18next behind ItemDetailModal/MilestoneJournalEntries/RoomTutorialDialog (the heaviest prose sites).

convergent_findings.title: 9×5 Duelyst board + hand cards are a bare canvas + clickable divs — keyboard- and screen-reader-inaccessible
convergent_findings.summary: The board renders as <canvas ref={canvasRef}/> with no aria-label/role/tabIndex/onKeyDown — keyboard users cannot focus a tile, screen-reader users get nothing for the 45-cell tactical surface. Hand slots are clickable divs (~line 1900), not buttons — keyboard-unreachable despite carrying aria-label. Concede/End Turn ARE real buttons; the primary play surface isn't. Compounds with mobile: .game-canvas-mount {touch-action:none} CSS rule exists in index.css purely so mobileWiring ship-check matches, but zero TSX consumers — the ship-check passes on file existence not runtime, the exact anti-pattern CLAUDE.md warns against.
convergent_findings.fix: Overlay parallel DOM grid: role='grid' aria-rowcount=5 aria-colcount=9 with one role='gridcell' per tile + aria-label='Row 3 Col 5, Maelis Drakar 4HP', roving tabindex on arrows, Enter/Space to commit. Convert hand cards to <button type='button'> with key handlers. Add className='game-canvas-mount' to all canvas wrappers. Tighten mobileWiring probe to grep TSX consumers, not just CSS declaration.

convergent_findings.title: Authoring/scaffolding mistaken for shipped: VARIANT_REGISTRY orphan, 5 stub VO manifests, 214 placeholder card flavors, lore-bible drift
convergent_findings.summary: Pattern across content-heavy domains: 3,464 LOC of authored morality/trust/act variants (VARIANT_REGISTRY) have no shipping consumer — only DevVariantsPage and contract tests import. Trust gating exists but no Act page passes companionStats into a resolver. 5 antagonist VO manifests are empty {} stubs (Authority, Eidola, Matrikala — all listed as shipping in Production Bible §3.2). 214 cards in s1_pack2/ ship 'Of the architect.' as flavor. LORE_BIBLE.md drifts from loredex-data.json (109 vs 113 chars, 95 vs 109 concepts). 95 'concepts' bucket has 5 Audit-* near-duplicates and Mystery-Engine internals leaking out. The deathwatch keyword on 25 cards is silently sugar (engine treats as exempt — same bug as drain at 5x scale).
convergent_findings.fix: Wire resolveVariant(VARIANT_REGISTRY) into act-page surfaces; add narrativeFlagConsumerCoverage ship-check entry. Author authority-lines.json + 4 sibling JSON, then pnpm vo:run-all. Run pnpm lore:generate; close lore.bible_drift ratchet. Rewrite s1_pack2 flavor (one line per card from song_character_map) + add card_flavor_quality ratchet (zero matches for /^Of the [a-z]+\.$/). Either auto-inject deathwatch trigger at card-load or strip the keyword from 25 cards.

convergent_findings.title: Casino RTP > 1.0 (negative house edge) compounds with no rate limit — sustained Dream printer
convergent_findings.summary: Slots EV = (1/216)*50 + (5/216)*5 + (90/216)*2 = 1.18 RTP (-18% house edge i.e. +18% PLAYER edge). Quantum Roulette 'adjacent' with 3 factions at 2.5x payout × 0.5 probability = 1.25 RTP (+25% player edge). VIP win bonus and 2% jackpot rake amplify for whales. Combined with no procedureRateLimit on casino.play* (C-02), an authed bot can grind premium currency at +18%/+25% expected return as fast as the server will accept requests. claimJackpot pays premium currency unbounded.
convergent_findings.fix: Drop slot triple-2x payout to 1.5x or shrink twoSame probability surface; cap roulette adjacent at 1.7x (3-faction) and quarter at 2.2x (2-faction). Add casinoGames.test.ts asserting RTP <= 0.92 across the bet space. Land the rate limits from C-02 in the same PR.

convergent_findings.title: Confession trial category has 4 cards (all Insurgency) — Authority §5.8 phase 7 unwinnable for 6 of 7 factions; thin evidence/reactive in TV+NB
convergent_findings.summary: Confession trial-category appears on only 4 cards corpus-wide, all Insurgency. Six of seven factions have zero confession cards — Authority Trial §5.8 phase 7 is therefore unwinnable for Architect/TV/NB/Dreamer/Antiquarian/Neutral decks regardless of skill. Thought Virus has 4 evidence / 13 reactive across 53 cards; New Babylon has 5 evidence / 4 reactive across 52 — below 30-card deck construction floor for trial-eligible cards across phases 3-8. Compounded by the playtester finding that the §5.8 UI offers zero player-facing explanation (no tut-authority-trial; jury/evidence/ink lines undocumented).
convergent_findings.fix: Backfill ≥2 confession-tagged cards per faction (≥12 total). Best candidates: existing reactive cards with self-cost. Tag ~8 more existing TV/NB cards with evidence/reactive (empire propaganda IS evidence). Use secondPassTrialCategorizer.ts. Author tut-authority-trial keyed to triggerRoute='/act1-c4-trial'. The TCG ratchet for trial coverage already exists (target 0) — drive it green.
